title: Confirmed downloaded redirect override is a no-op
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: Enable a downloaded redirect for redirect.example; open Redirected; turn its checkbox off and confirm Yes. Also invoke its contextual Move.
expected: The offered override creates an effective user exception or is unavailable with authoritative checkbox state.
observed: BASELINE Source trace: the checkbox changes first; Yes calls moveListItem; REDIRECTED immediately returns without a write or refresh. Contextual Move is also offered and returns.
fix: Implemented downloaded redirect move as exact ALLOWED with null redirection plus selected source-row disable and stats in one Room transaction; user redirect Move hidden; other redirects preserved and warning explains precedence.
test_evidence: Authored 3 redirect/Move UI and Room cases in ListsRuleFixesInstrumentedTest; API-image javac passed; none run. Redirect-first DAO precedence source-confirmed; no global override/import policy changes.

title: Canceling a downloaded toggle can make the next enable persist disabled
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: Enabled downloaded block; turn off; cancel confirmation using Back without a reload; click the still-off row to turn on.
expected: Cancel restores current row truth and checked=true cannot persist enabled=false.
observed: BASELINE Source trace: only the No button resets the visual state. Back leaves checkbox=false and entity=true; the next checked=true branch negates entity true to false.
fix: Adapter retains authoritative bound state during every confirmation outcome; explicit setItemEnabled copies entities; row identity uses database ID; no cancel-time filter mutation.
test_evidence: Main phase-three API34 log:12 of13 rules cases passed including outside-touch No checkbox-Back and explicit-state; row-Back timed out at confirmation dismissal before DB assertions. Fixture source lacked a window-focus barrier; actual failed Back destination unobserved. Back now waits for attached laid-out focused dialog and injects one checked UiAutomation DOWN/UP pair. All post-cancel DB checkbox and subsequent-change assertions are byte-identical to index; outside-touch code unchanged. Android API-image javac passed; corrected Back runtime pending main.

title: Retained tabs display a stale query while sharing a newer filter
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: Keep Blocked and Allowed views alive; search alpha in Blocked; search beta in Allowed; return to Blocked with alpha/beta fixture rows.
expected: The visible query always describes displayed rows whether search is shared or tab-local.
observed: BASELINE Source trace: every tab writes the Activity filter and all streams observe it; each editor only copies the query at creation. Blocked retains alpha text while its rows use beta.
fix: Shared distinct query LiveData; bind editors after hierarchy restoration with feedback guard and editor-save disabled; cache each Paging stream in ViewModel scope for recreation.
test_evidence: Authored retained two-tab query/rows plus activity recreation and clear-search case; API-image javac passed; 10 existing pure filter tests passed; Android execution pending.

title: Background mutation refresh can replace a newer user filter
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: Set alpha; pause a completing add/edit task after refresh reads its filter; on main set beta or toggle sources; resume background refresh and drain posted delivery.
expected: Mutation completion refreshes rows without undoing a newer query or source visibility selection.
observed: BASELINE Source trace: diskIO snapshots the full filter then postValue publishes it later; newer main-thread setValue has no generation protection against the queued old snapshot.
fix: Removed every mutation-driven filter refresh; Room table invalidation refreshes rows without copying user filter state; identical search input is ignored.
test_evidence: Authored held-main/disk-completion interleaving plus latest query/source scope and same-filter subsequent insert checks; API-image javac passed; Android execution pending.

title: Accepted long wildcard line is silently skipped when adding allow rules
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: Allowed multiline input has example.com followed by 244 asterisks (255 characters) then control.example on a new line; press Add.
expected: Every accepted line persists or is rejected visibly before dismissal; add and edit use one length policy.
observed: BASELINE Source trace: wildcard removal leaves valid example.com so dialog validation passes; ViewModel silently returns for raw length over 253. Control line alone is submitted; no rejected-line feedback exists.
fix: Reject raw wildcard length over253 before normalization; add/edit share write validation and return acceptance; Allowed dialog surfaces length error and disables Add/Save including existing invalid edits.
